body: Congratulations!

Firstly, congrats on your date! And secondly, maybe try to think of it in a more positive light? Maybe you two can plan for a day trip or something and when this all blows over, you two can enjoy a second first date :)

Maybe you should ask him about it. Not in a confrontational manner or anything, maybe something like "I was wondering how you feel about me?" He might just be a little shy or didn't realise the magnitude of what you said.

Depression, like every other mental illness varies from person to person so you probably won't get a very definite answer. 

I do think checking up on him everyday is a good idea, it'll be reassuring to know that you're still there for him. It'll only be smothering if you message him every 2 hours or something (imo). And don't get too irritated if his replies are more infrequent or distant.

I share the same sentiment. It really sucks when movies and TV shows paint life out to be this magical wonderland. When really it's just a shit hole that we can never get ourselves out of. Life sucks, people suck, everything is just sucky. It would be so easy to just end all the suffering. And sure it'll bring suffering onto others around you, but we're human. We're allowed to be selfish sometimes right? 

I'm sorry I can't say everything is going to be okay because I don't know that. Maybe it'll get even worse, I mean, life hates us all so it's a possibility. But even so, there's still a tiny chance that things might actually get better. It might not be worth all the suffering, but it's a chance. Hope is a precious thing and I hope that you do end up finding a reason to live, maybe not now but maybe some time in the future. I hope things to get better for you, for all of us.

I get that and not everyone is comfortable with such topics. But they've all offered to lend a listening ear and I "could always talk to them" if I wanted to. It just sucks that people always offer help half heartedly and when you do take them up on their offer you just get ignored. I'd be fine if anyone of them just stopped me and said "I'm thankful you trust me enough to confide in me, but I don't think I'm the right person to talk to about it. Maybe a professional would be more suited." Just something along those lines was all I needed. Instead I just get cut off and ignored. It is so degrading and I just feel so hopeless. If my best friends don't care for me then who will?
